source: export.monster.Monster34.initBBDC()+setAction() in 打开我开始玩.swf; sheet 4.swf chid1 Monster34. 邪.悟空 (Evil Wukong), 4th/final link in level-4's sequential boss chain (Monster31.destroy() spawns this). This is the level's true boss: its destroy() is the only one of the four with `if(this.isBoss){ ...transferDoorArray visible=true }`, revealing the exit regardless of it not having the chain's highest hp (67612 belongs to Monster33; this one is 54423) — confirmed from AS3, not guessed. Single unbranched constructor, isBoss=true unconditional. Unlike 31/32/33, this monster has a genuinely distinct walk row (row2) separate from run (row3). Row4 is a shared pose bank (jump1 col0/jump3 col1/hit9 col2/hit10 col3/hit11_1 col4/hit11_2 col5); row12 is a second pose bank (hit12 col0/hit7 col1/hurt col2/hit13 col3) — only hurt is encoded from it (1 frame). No dedicated dead row (alpha-fade only) — omitted. Recovered stats in data/levels/level4.ts.
